Highlights:
The 2026 summer royalty for Nanga Parbat (8,126 m) is USD 1,800 per foreign member. Expeditions apply through a registered operator at least 45 days ahead.

# Nanga Parbat royalty 2026

| Season | Royalty per foreign member |
| --- | --- |
| Summer (June – August) | USD 1,800 |
| Winter (December – February) | USD 400 |

Apply through a registered operator at least 45 days before arrival. A liaison officer is assigned to every expedition; the operator pays the officer's kit allowance.
